Star Wars: Echoes of War takes place in the year 3906 BBY, 50 years after the disappearance of Revan. The server follows the canon ending of Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic I, but does not follow the events of KOTOR II, instead following its own timeline. Viscara (the primary Hub of the server) finds itself in the unique - and precarious - position of having come out of the war as an independent system, if not entirely unscathed. 

Ostensibly, the planetary control is centered in Veles, and currently within the hands of the Czerka Corporation. The atmosphere of the city itself depends entirely on how much the Corporation likes (or tolerates) you, and how much credits you have. 

More broadly, Czerka's grip might not be as strong as it seems. 

The surface of Viscara still maintains a Republic presence, albeit a diminished one, though it would still count as the second largest fighting force on the planet. The commander of this base is eager to see the citizens of Veles brought under the benevolent rule of the Republic, free from the oppressive conditions under the Czerka Corporation. The means to do so is presently non-existent, however, due to being unable to receive any sort of reinforcements. 

Cutting off the Republic influence (and increased presence) is a moderately sized Imperial fleet that makes regular 'patrols' through the system and nearby sectors. Though the Empire that rose under Revan and then Malak is shattered, warlords of various strength and other remnant factions continue to maintain a hold on some systems and planets. 

The Viscaran system presents a tempting opportunity for other major players. Bounty Hunters, Mercenaries, Smugglers, ex-Military, and Freedom Fighters all might find a suitable place to advance their interests by working for or subverting the known factions. 

And outside of these known factions other mysterious interests lurk, from criminal cartels to as yet unknown entities, all watching this wayward Czerka holding with interest if not outright greed.
